Name: Hallows_Eve_Gravekeeper_Restless
$Comment: The Gravekeeper's full moon conversation, what pressing F on him opens in the Forgotten Temple on a
full moon outside Hallow's Eve (his placement NpcPlacements/Hallows_Eve_Gravekeeper_Restless_Temple.json).
During Hallow's Eve his other placement stands him there with his Hallow's Eve conversation
(Hallows_Eve_Gravekeeper.json), so nothing here is ever offered then. He speaks as he always does:
Every visit opens on greeting: the dead are restless under the full moon, and putting down
skeletons and zombies while it is up earns favor with the Hallowed (the Undead row in
Reputations/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Hallowed.json). Its lines are who he is, the same words as
his Hallow's Eve who screen, and goodnight; the who screen carries gk_back, back to the greeting or
goodnight. The lines reuse his Hallow's Eve conversation's keys, so a translation covers both.
It opens no graveyard and gates nothing: the placement's Season is the only gate. To add a line,
put it in gk_greeting before goodnight. The trick-or-treat line never lands here, since its Season
is Hallow's Eve, and Harvest Feast's invitation line leaves this conversation out by name.
